notes: LB.sas derives the CDISC SDTM Laboratory Test (LB) domain end-to-end: inner-joins raw LAB to DM, maps PARAM to LBTEST/LBTESTCD, derives LBCAT from a SUBSTR of LABT_, standardizes result/unit/range vars, flags LBNRIND, builds LBDRVFL, resolves VISIT via a PROC FORMAT, derives LBDTC/LBDY from date informats, then computes VISITNUM/LBSEQ via first./last. BY-group logic and assembles the final 24-var LB dataset. Substitution: the external MYSNIP library ('/home/u63305936/...' SAS OnDemand path) is replaced by two inline datalines DATA steps building mysnip.lab (13 rows across 3 subjects/several visits, covering the mapped PARAM values and both HEMATOLOGY/CHEMISTRY/URINALYSIS categories) and mysnip.dm (3 subjects); the hardcoded PROC EXPORT OUTFILE path is rewritten to a relative ./LB_Dataset.xlsx. Derivation logic is byte-identical to the author's. Reproducible across two POSTs. exit_code 1 comes from a benign upstream WARNING (DATA LB6 (DROP=Visit) names Visit, the variable is Visitd) that real SAS 9.4 also emits; not a Jenner bug.
